notes.title: Dev Log 03 – Impetan: The Beast Born from Wrath
notes.content:
Think you’ve mastered Rage Skills in our game? Think again.
Meet Impetan—a mysterious summon born from the Impetus skill.

[h3][b]So, what exactly is Impetan?[/b][/h3]
Impetan isn’t just a companion pet. It’s like your rebellious shadow, carrying your power yet acting on its own.
[list]
[*] Impetan borrows your HP, armor, damage, crit… and charges into battle like a dark warrior.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/285ab76088a8ee5e3fea8d63c4566fee7ea61551.gif[/img]
[*] Every time you take damage—or every enemy Impetan slays—your skill cooldowns refresh faster.
[*] You slap fast → it attacks fast. You slow down → it drags behind.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/1950d20570bbfec7fc0f5af84fb81a24c9b883d9.gif[/img]
[*] When Impetan dies, it leaves behind a grave. Sacrifice your HP to resurrect it right there. A chilling deal… but worth the cost.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/b64b7d3b8163bf7d30a596bef2ff905220f923ff.gif[/img]
[/list]
[b][h3]But that’s not all…[/h3][/b]
Impetan hides more surprises that will make you both love it and fear it:
[list]
[*] With the right artifact, you can summon two Impetans at once (“More of Us” and  “Echo of Life”)→ chaos guaranteed.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/50f2eec07d6cfa177aa37f0225736ef24dce76c8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/d10b8ce212389fabe07e97fb55311243cb5fbc57.png[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/c2acc176ae48389eeae2d10fc0fe48aad1bfbb36.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/164526003c9c45d01d4cff110198613a6ef1659c.png[/img][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/d2c46dd96217239394ac3173e61132c409689505.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/bd43309360c917c21ea037f131a344e2525987aa.gif[/img]
[*] Its size scales with yours. Become a giant? It becomes colossal. Shrink down? It turns into your eerie little shadow.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/d6683249b1e6f2e7564f4dda28bb2a0a42eddf14.gif[/img]
[*] Don’t assume it’s blindly loyal. Sometimes Impetan acts unpredictably—and if you’re careless, you might become its prey. It will take away the healing items that are dropped when you kill monsters.
[*] When Donald Heart enters the field… prepare yourself for a bloody internal war.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/ba504cd6edfe08bc0be2a31dc73e06ae81765842.gif[/img]
[*] And here is the image of Impetan in the first version.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/0459b7f36a9b7972843cd3a1e0b89af1bcb98dce.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/738329d7dd960f1f864dfcf09b4559fb621764b5.png[/img][/url]
[/list]

[h3][b]Why should you try it?[/b][/h3]
Impetan isn’t just another skill. It’s an entirely new playstyle that forces bold decisions:
[list]
[*] Will you sacrifice blood to bring your dark ally back from the grave?
[*] Will you risk fighting alongside a beast that protects you… Yet might turn on you?
[*] Will you push your build to the limit and watch Impetan evolve into a true monster?
[/list]
That’s the thrill of Impetan: ultimate power, wrapped in a dangerous gamble.

We promise—you’ll never forget your first battle with Impetan.

notes.title: Devlog 2 – Extreme Mode: Only the Brave Will Finish
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
 We’ve been hard at work cooking up new content, and this update brings both fresh faces and new mechanics into the fray. While Run 2 is still in an experimental balancing phase, we wanted to share a preview of what’s coming so you know what to expect once it’s ready for release.

[h3][b]1. Added new enemy variants (Run 2 – balancing still in progress)
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/22e519e11fbc231a39d778f024347324b6a4d6a9.gif[/img]
 Several new enemy variants, along with entirely new foes, are making their debut:
[list]
[*] Vine Girl – She’ll mischievously entangle your screen with her vines, making it harder for you to land those satisfying hits.
[*] Red Bunny Girl – Agile and relentless, she’ll hop around non-stop to dodge your slaps, requiring quick reflexes to catch her.
[/list]

At the current stage of internal testing, Run 2 is extremely challenging due to the lack of balance. We’ll be fine-tuning it to create a fair but still intense experience when it becomes available to you.

[h3][b]2. New Boss for Run 2 – Slime Girl[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/a01800814b5ca68e0fa9f34e9c7876870b4582ae.gif[/img]
 A brand-new boss, Slime Girl, will be waiting in Run 2. She’s wet, unpredictable, and capable of overwhelming you if you’re not careful. Her design is intended to push players’ adaptability and timing skills to the limit.

[h3][b]3. Magic Damage system (from Intelligence stat)[/b][/h3]
 A new Magic Damage mechanic has been added, derived from the Intelligence stat. This change aims to reduce over-reliance on Strength-based builds and open up new playstyles for magic users. Intelligence will now be a much more impactful choice in your build.

[h3][b]4. Around 7–10 new Artifacts[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/8edfea515756b7d89e4bba6b109ca3033e01806d.gif[/img]
 This update includes 7–10 new Artifacts, balanced to support a variety of playstyles: traditional physical damage, summoning builds, and spellcasting-focused strategies. Each one is designed to create new approaches to combat and deepen gameplay diversity.

[h3][b]5. WIP – Cowgirl H-scene[/b][/h3]
Lastly, the Cowgirl H-scene is still in production. We’re putting extra effort into making sure it’s worth the wait.

[h3][b]Final words[/b][/h3]
This devlog is just a glimpse of what’s currently being tested and refined. While Run 2 is shaping up to be one of the toughest challenges in the game, we’re working to ensure it’s not only difficult but also fair and rewarding once it reaches you. Stay tuned for when you can get your hands on it!

[h3][b]What are you waiting for? Add it to your wishlist to get notified when the game launches!
[/b][/h3]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3264850/That_Time_I_Got_Reincarnated_as_a_Perverted_Hand/?curator_clanid=44790310

See you soon!
— PK - Tora Creatives

notes.title: Devlog 01 – The Cow Boss Is Real, and It’s Angry
notes.content:
Hey friends!
 It’s been a chaotic but super fun week working on one of the most ridiculous bosses in our game so far — and today, we’re finally ready to share it with you: Boss Cow 🐄
Now, we don’t want to spoil everything, but here’s a sneak peek at the cow’s current skill set and some behind-the-scenes nonsense that happened while building it!

[h3][b]Boss Cow's Skills (With Visuals – You’ll Want to See This)[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/5aff93767770102dca0f8c4b5ab37ee71174b84e.gif[/img]
[b]Charge Attack[/b]
 This cow isn’t just mad — it’s relentless. It charges full speed straight at you, over and over again. You will need to stay on the move or get absolutely flattened.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/2ae447608832f177bfa4e888dea8e31a5545014d.gif[/img]
[b] Projectile Burst[/b]
 At certain points, the cow goes wild and fires off projectiles in every direction. It’s chaotic, a little unfair, and honestly kind of funny watching bullets go everywhere like it’s a bullet hell rave.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/7bf645538322c82667d368eca47d0527d1028449.gif[/img]
[b]Milk Bottle Toss[/b]
 Yup. It throws a milk bottle.
 But it’s not for drinking — when it lands, it creates a slow zone that makes your character move like they’re stuck in pudding. Watch your step.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/5ddfc34ff0b0ebd8e71af847799f832782116790.gif[/img]
[b] Laser Spin[/b]
 Possibly the most dangerous skill. The cow fires a laser beam, then spins non-stop, sweeping the whole arena. It’s part dance party, part “you’re not surviving this” unless your dodging game is on point.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340328/abd1cc18e8431740b9209d691bbae891c8d45067.gif[/img]
[b]UFO Drop[/b]
 Because cows and UFOs go hand in hand, right?
 The cow calls in a flying saucer from the sky that drops straight down to crush you. It’s slow at first, but if you’re not paying attention… well, goodbye.
	UFO Chaos
 	Bonus twist: if the cow accidentally charges into the UFO, it goes bouncing across the screen like a giant pinball, dealing damage to anything in its way. It wasn’t planned, but it’s hilarious — so we kept it.
	Laser Reflection
 Oh, and if a laser hits a UFO?
 Yeah. It reflects in random directions. Sometimes it hits you. Sometimes it hits the cow. Sometimes… it hits nothing.
 You’ve been warned.

[h3][b]Behind-the-Scenes Cow Nonsense (a.k.a. things we did for the meme)[/b][/h3]
Okay so, some of these skills came from actual game design, sure.
 But others? Total accidents. Or worse — jokes that became features.
[list]
[*] The UFO idea came from that old meme about “UFOs abducting cows” in American pop culture. Naturally, we thought it’d be funny.
[*] Problem is, our cow is too fat. The UFO tries to suck it up… and fails.
[*] Someone on the team said, “what if the player could hide inside the UFO to avoid lasers?” — and, uh, now you can.
[*] The “jump smash” skill was literally the cow tripping and faceplanting. We animated it as a joke, then said: “wait... that kinda slaps?”
[/list]
 So now it’s canon.

[h3][b]So what’s next?[/b][/h3]
We’re still polishing this boss fight and adding more little chaotic surprises.
 If you have ideas, thoughts, or you just want to share how many times the cow beat you up — we’d love to hear it!
Thanks again for supporting us on this weird, wonderful game journey.
 We’ll keep building the madness, one angry bovine at a time 🐄💥

See you soon!
 — PK - Tora Creatives
